messages:
Ava (Design): Quick design review — noticed the primary button's loading micro-animation feels jittery on 90% of our dashboard interactions. Also the tooltip copy for 'saving' vs 'saved' is inconsistent across forms. Thoughts?
Sam (Frontend): Saw this in staging earlier today :eyes: ... guessing it's the reflow when we swap children inside the button. Could try absolute positioning for the spinner.
Maya (A11y): Also flagging accessibility: focus ring on primary button drops below contrast on our dark variant. We should ensure focus indicator meets at least 3:1 on large interactive components. Also add `prefers-reduced-motion` support for the spinner.
Jordan (Eng): Agree on absolute spinner. Quick CSS test I tried fixes jitter: 
```css
.button { position: relative; }
.button .spinner { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: auto; }
.button .label { visibility: hidden; }
```
But we need to keep screen reader semantics: use `aria-live`/`aria-busy` instead of visually hiding labels.
Ava (Design): Thanks Jordan — that helps. For tooltip copy, propose standardizing to: "Saving…" while in-flight, then "Saved" on success, and "Save failed" on error. Keep verbs present-tense for consistency. Also update microcopy in the batch-save modal.
Sam (Frontend): I'll prototype with CSS + `aria-hidden` for the label and `sr-only` text for screen readers. Plan: add `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` toggling to swap spinner to a static icon.
Maya (A11y): For focus ring contrast, recommend using the 2px outline with color #FFDE7A on dark bg — test shows 4.2:1, but if we can't reach 4.5:1 we should increase thickness or add a subtle backdrop. I'll add a quick accessibility note in the ticket.
Ava (Design): Nice. Can we also make the tooltip copy editable from the design tokens file? So PMs can tweak without touching the component. Suggest `tooltip.copy.saving`, `tooltip.copy.saved`, `tooltip.copy.error`.
Jordan (Eng): Sounds fine. I'll open a PR that adds: spinner absolute positioning, `prefers-reduced-motion` rule, `aria-busy` handling, and exposes tooltip keys. Linking draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/2345
Sam (Frontend): I'll add a visual regression test for the button states and ensure storybook stories exist for reduced-motion and dark variant.
Redwood Deploy Bot: Staging deploy triggered for branch fix/button-loading-a11y — build 4021 started :rocket:
Ava (Design): Thanks team — putting a quick note on design board and closing the review after PR merges. :sparkles:
